$comment: Windows desktop workflow and ownership contract; see ../WINDOWS-EXPERIENCE.markdown. Uses the existing shared Prayer shape and SQLite database.

home.order: homeWidgetOrder stores newline-separated known unique identifiers. Absent uses defaultCards; an explicit empty value stays empty. Add appends, Remove preserves the remaining order, and Customize Home offers native drag reorder plus Move Up and Move Down controls.
home.date: Window-local Today selected date; follow the local clock only while Today is selected. Home visibility is independent of the legacy Today visibility preferences.
home.reminders: Show enabled reminders from the existing saved-prayer store and Today settings. Manage Reminders selects any saved prayer, including one with no existing reminder, or Today settings.
home.photo: Native picture picker, decode validation, private LocalFolder/HomePhotos copy, persisted homePhotoPath. Replacement/removal deletes the previous private file. Cancellation and owner/page closure do not replace the selected photo.
home.reflection: Empty until the supplied mission text is available; no freeform editor.
home.feast: Offline selected-calendar title/rank and exact-interface-language sourced descriptions, credit and source links; explicit unavailable messages for absent feast or description.

search.placement: Dedicated Library sidebar destination; View > Search or Ctrl+F activates the library and focuses its query field.
search.community: Visible Community Prayers action opens the catalog browser from Search. Community is no longer a top-level sidebar or View menu destination.
search.categories: Union of manifest tags in local and available community catalogs, plus All Categories and Other for untagged prayers. Arbitrary tags remain discoverable; localized captions do not replace stable tag identity.
search.filter: Selected category AND text query apply to both local and community results. A blank query browses the category. Installed community entries are excluded from the download results.
search.navigation: Local results launch through the owning WindowNavigation into independent prayer windows. Installing a community pack refreshes discovery and Gallery without creating a saved library copy.
search.offline: Local category browsing and search remain available if the remote catalog cannot load.

library.contents: Saved Prayer records, with searchable list/grid views and selection-targeted commands.
library.open: Ordinary Open, Enter or double-click activates the exact saved UUID's prayer window.
library.add: Gallery Add creates a fresh saved Prayer with a unique display name; the first saved copy of a devotion is its default.
library.duplicate: New UUID and unique name, independent progress, copied options, new disabled reminder IDs, isDefault false.
library.rename: Preserves UUID and uses an update-only write.
library.delete: Existing removal confirmation/service, sibling preservation and final-download cleanup; closes the deleted UUID's prayer window.
library.notifications: Publish shared library changes only after a successful write; stale update-only writes do not recreate deleted records.

windows.library: One retained MainWindow, recreated by Show Library after closure.
windows.savedPrayer: saved:<Prayer UUID>, reuses the existing native PrayerWindow.
windows.basicPrayer: basic:<stable prayer ID>, reuses the existing native PrayerWindow.
windows.navigation: Each Frame has its own WindowNavigation and owning Window in Router's weak registry.
windows.close: Root prayer Back/Finish closes only that window; library and sibling windows remain. Closing a prayer releases audio and auto-advance.
windows.asyncOwnership: Dialogs, pickers and continuations retain the initiating window and stop UI work after it closes.
windows.customProgress: Saved generic series and bookmarks use desktop:<Prayer UUID>:<bundle ID>; unsaved native sessions substitute their window-local UUID. Detached legacy callers retain bundle identity.
windows.saveSession: Adopts the new saved UUID without re-navigation; current checkpoint and series state move from that isolated session, and title/settings/deletion target the saved copy.
windows.legacyProgress: Existing bundle-wide custom bookmarks/series remain stored but are not assigned to saved copies. Existing options/language/dayIndex remain; Rosary and Jesus saved UUID checkpoints retain their keys.
windows.missingUUID: Never substitute a saved sibling or default.

menus.placement: Native WinUI MenuBar inside each window, with CommandBars for frequent page actions.
menus.availability: Prayer actions resolve their own frame and current flow state.

today.placement: Dedicated Library destination with native Acrylic date controls and calendar flyout above the content.
today.citations: Full localized book/chapter/verse citations, with no shorthand toggle.
today.clock: Advance at local midnight when following today; retain a deliberately browsed date.

fullScriptureText.presentation: Daily and enabled Torah passages start collapsed on entry and date/calendar changes unless expandReadingsByDefault is enabled. They remain independently collapsible, showing selectable numbered Bible verses with edition name, attribution and source link. Edition text is identified as a Bible passage and may differ from local Mass wording.
fullScriptureText.loading: The small readings-editions.json manifest populates the picker; readings-texts.json loads only on passage expansion.
fullScriptureText.lookup: Exact daily|<raw ReadingCitation.Full> for the six established datasets, daily|<dataset ID>|<raw ReadingCitation.Full> for new datasets, or torah|<raw ReadingCitation.Full>, plus edition ID. Citation captures actual reading filename suffix before asynchronous expansion; LPJ is roman and UGCC captures its actual Pascha table. Scoped keys never fall back to Roman. No runtime reference parser or inferred versification.
fullScriptureText.selection: readingsEditionId empty matches the interface language with iw/he and fil/tl normalization. Explicit choices use only that metadata ID. No matching edition, missing appointment, or invalid verse rows show unavailable without changing the citation or falling back to another edition.
fullScriptureText.state: Changing date, calendar/Pascha setting, language or edition refreshes the appropriate rows. Ordinary refreshes and edition changes preserve individual collapses; reopening the view expands all passages. Typeface changes refresh displayed Scripture without replacing source text; Arabic/Hebrew passages use RTL.
